content.title: Chapter 30 - ELECTIONS — Sec. 30-66. - Setting of election upon certification of sufficiency and resolution.
content.summary:
When the petition is determined to be sufficient by the city clerk, the city clerk
               shall submit the original petition, certificate of sufficiency, and a resolution setting
               the date of the election to the city council for consideration.
(Code 1981, § 11-37; Ord. No. 3511…
